name: Tés (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner with a white triangle descending from the top edge to a point near the bottom over a blue field, charged in the triangle with the municipal arms of Tés: a blue shield with a white windmill and crossed tools.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: inverted triangle from the top edge
